_note: Generated by scripts/build_dataset_mapping.py from dataset_registry. Official datasets are the only runtime data source; legacy/ synthetic CSVs are never read at runtime.

crop_production.source: Tamil Nadu Data / Dept of Economics & Statistics - Season & Crop Report
crop_production.provides: district x crop x season area (total / irrigated / unirrigated), production, yield
used_by: NSGA-II (f1 yield, f2 cost, f3 irrigated area)

crop_state_series.source: Tamil Nadu Data / Dept of Economics & Statistics - Season & Crop Report

land_use.source: Tamil Nadu Data / Dept of Economics & Statistics - Season & Crop Report
land_use.provides: district land-use classification (net / gross area sown, fallow, forest ...)

irrigation.source: Tamil Nadu Data / Dept of Economics & Statistics - Season & Crop Report
irrigation.provides: irrigated area by source and by crop

rainfall.source: IMD district rainfall as published in the Season & Crop Report
rainfall.provides: monthly / seasonal actual and normal rainfall, % deviation

groundwater.source: Tamil Nadu Data - groundwater level (as supplied in GOVT DATASETS)

reservoir_storage.source: Tamil Nadu Water Resources Department - daily reservoir levels
reservoir_storage.provides: daily reservoir storage (from 2025-01-01) mapped to districts

msp_and_cost.source: CACP / Dept of Agriculture MSP notifications (official PDFs, KMS/RMS 2022-23 .. 2025-26)
msp_and_cost.provides: MSP Rs/quintal and CACP projected cost of cultivation A2+FL Rs/quintal

agronomy_doses.provides: recommended N, P2O5, K2O (and S) doses per crop with condition and page evidence

soil_health.source: Soil Health Card portal (soilhealth.dac.gov.in) - nutrient dashboard 2024-25
soil_health.provides: district sample counts by class: N, P, K, OC, pH, EC, S and micronutrients

disabled_features.missing_dataset: IMD district weather: observed temperature, humidity, forecast

disabled_features.feature: Crop water requirement in mm / irrigation litres (NSGA-II f3)
disabled_features.missing_dataset: Crop-wise water requirement (mm) - TNAU guide gives schedules, not totals
disabled_features.source: TNAU crop guides (per-crop pages) / Agriculture Dept
disabled_features.scope: f3 uses irrigated area share instead

disabled_features.missing_dataset: Notified fertiliser prices (Dept. of Fertilizers) - not loaded
disabled_features.scope: scenario lever only; cost objective uses CACP cost of cultivation

disabled_features.feature: Labour / pesticide cost, crop duration, sowing & harvest months
disabled_features.missing_dataset: Per-crop cultivation calendar and input costs (TNAU / CACP state cost tables)

disabled_features.feature: Crops without TNAU dose or CACP cost (e.g. horticulture, coconut, sugarcane, pulses beyond MSP list)
disabled_features.missing_dataset: TNAU horticulture guide doses; MSP/FRP and cost of cultivation for the report year
disabled_features.scope: crop excluded from candidate lists (reason shown)

disabled_features.feature: Cotton and rice as optimisation candidates
disabled_features.missing_dataset: Official conversion factors: kapas to lint (ginning outturn) and paddy to rice (milling outturn); official yield is lint / rice, MSP and CACP cost are per quintal kapas / paddy
disabled_features.source: CACP / Dept. of Agriculture TN / Season & Crop Report notes
disabled_features.scope: crop excluded from candidate lists (reason shown); nothing converted with an assumed factor

disabled_features.feature: Reservoir storage for Kharif 2024 and for districts without a mapped reservoir
disabled_features.missing_dataset: Reservoir daily levels before 2025-01-01; district command-area map
disabled_features.scope: fuzzy stage skipped for the district/season (yield left unadjusted, flagged)

disabled_features.feature: District year-on-year trends and multi-year history
disabled_features.missing_dataset: Season & Crop Reports of earlier years (district level)
